description: Peec AI is an AI search analytics platform for tracking brand visibility, competitors, sources, and related performance data across AI assistants and search experiences. It also offers workflows for agencies and teams to analyze and manage project data programmatically.
summary: peec.ai exposes two documented developer surfaces on `api.peec.ai`: a streamable-HTTP MCP server at `/mcp` authenticated by OAuth or a personal access token, and a Customer REST API at `/customer/v1` authenticated by API key.
